title: Two newly hatched chicks
hook: Hatchlings can start life at different stages.

knows: Animals have structures and activities that can be studied.
doesNotKnow: The illustrated domestic chicken chick is downy, eyes open, and can move soon after hatching; a newly hatched robin is comparatively helpless and depends heavily on parental care. These are examples of precocial and altricial development, not a rule for every bird.

misconception: The features shown in this question have only one possible interpretation.
objective: A newly hatched robin and a newly hatched domestic chicken are compared. Which is typically more able to move around shortly after hatching?

claims.text: Hatchlings can start life at different stages. A newly hatched robin and a newly hatched domestic chicken are compared. Which is typically more able to move around shortly after hatching? The illustrated domestic chicken chick is downy, eyes open, and can move soon after hatching; a newly hatched robin is comparatively helpless and depends heavily on parental care. These are examples of precocial and altricial development, not a rule for every bird.
